How it works

  1. 1

    Pick a deck

    Funny, deep or a little tricky: every deck has its own mood.

  2. 2

    Draw a card

    Read it out loud. On the couch, on a date or on a video call.

  3. 3

    Talk

    The card is just the start. Ask follow-ups, tell stories, be honest.
